description: Delete one of your folders for good. The first call without confirm:true only says what would happen; nothing changes until confirm is true. What is in it stays in your library, or with cascade:true goes to the trash (it can be brought back). A folder with folders inside it is refused. Free.

cascade.description: Send the folder's items to the trash too. Default false: they stay in the library.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes to what the first call described.

name: delete_my_folder
title: Delete Folder
